title: Dutch Republic
capsule: The Republic of the Seven United Provinces (Republiek der Zeven Verenigde Nederlanden) emerged from the Union of Utrecht in 1579 and formally abjured Spanish sovereignty in 1581, waging the Eighty Years' War until the Peace of Westphalia (1648) confirmed its independence. Under the commercial dominance of the province of Holland and through the Dutch East India Company (VOC, founded 1602) and West India Company (WIC, 1621), the Republic became the world's leading maritime trading power in the seventeenth century, establishing colonies and trading posts from Batavia to New Amsterdam. The Republic's structure — a confederation of sovereign provinces governed by an Estates-General and stadholders from the House of Orange — proved durable until French Revolutionary armies installed the Batavian Republic in 1795, formally ending the old polity.
